name: Natori Ruka
source:
A first-year who's famous for having dramatic friendships.

He has a cheerful personality and a lot of friends, and he's always the center of attention.

He loves having fun, and it seems as though he recommended himself for this project, but...?

Yandere attribute: ******

"I'm so happy, I was just thinking how nice it would be if I could work with you."

(Translated from official website)
